name: io.github.tonyyang0504/binance_spot-mcp
description: Binance Spot (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles, get_balances, list_orders, place_

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_SPOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Binance API key (sent as X-MBX-APIKEY). Create it under API Management with withdrawals OFF; restrict it to your IP. For the spot testnet create a separate key at https://testnet.binance.vision and point adapter.base_url at https://testnet.binance.vision (the testnet key does not work on api.binance.com and vice versa).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_SPOT_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The key's HMAC secret: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the exact query string, appended as `signature` after `timestamp`). Never sent on the wire.
